headline: 12 Press Releases You Need to See This Week
summary: With thousands of press releases published each week, it can be difficult to keep up with everything on PR Newswire. To help journalists and consumers stay on top of the week's most newsworthy and popular releases, here's a recap of some major stories from the week that shouldn't be missed.

headline: Garmin (GRMN) Is Buying TrainingPeaks And TrainHeroic While Launching CIRQA
summary: Garmin (NYSE:GRMN) has acquired TrainingPeaks and TrainHeroic, two leading digital fitness platforms for endurance and strength athletes. The company has also launched the CIRQA Smart Band, a subscription free, screen free fitness tracker focused on discreet health and fitness monitoring. These moves expand Garmin's position across both software and hardware in the fitness and wellness market.
